Title: Power-up state and FET outputs
Expected_Result:
Step 1: State INIT, both FETs OFF
Step 3: State IDLE, Faults 0x00, both FETs ON

Title: Over-voltage boundary 4199 / 4200 mV
Expected_Result:
Step 3: no fault, IDLE
Step 6: FAULT, Faults 0x01 (OV), both FETs OFF

Title: Over-voltage debounce timing (300 ms)
Expected_Result:
Step 3: not in FAULT, FETs ON (200 ms)
Step 5: FAULT, FETs OFF (300 ms)

Title: Over-voltage hysteresis and clear
Expected_Result:
Step 3: ERR,FAULT_ACTIVE
Step 6: OK,CLEARED
Step 7: IDLE, FETs ON

Title: Under-voltage boundary and release
Steps:
1. @CELLS 3001  then @TICK 5  then status
2. @CELLS 3000  then @TICK 3  then status
3. @CELLS 3099  then @TICK 1  then CLEAR_FAULTS
4. @CELLS 3100  then @TICK 1  then CLEAR_FAULTS
Expected_Result:
1: no fault
2: FAULT 0x02 (UV)
3: ERR,FAULT_ACTIVE
4: OK,CLEARED

Title: Over-temperature boundary and release
Steps:
1. @TEMP 599  then @TICK 5  then status
2. @TEMP 600  then @TICK 3  then status
3. @TEMP 551  then @TICK 1  then CLEAR_FAULTS
4. @TEMP 550  then @TICK 1  then CLEAR_FAULTS
Expected_Result:
1: no fault
2: FAULT 0x04 (OT)
3: ERR,FAULT_ACTIVE
4: OK,CLEARED

Title: Over-current discharge and charge limits
Steps:
1. @CUR -29999  then @TICK 5  then status
2. @CUR -30000  then @TICK 3  then status
3. @RESET  then @TICK 1
4. @CUR 9999  then @TICK 5  then status
5. @CUR 10000  then @TICK 3  then status
Expected_Result:
1: DISCHARGING, no fault
2: FAULT 0x08 (OC)
4: CHARGING, no fault
5: FAULT 0x08 (OC)

Title: Open-wire cell sensor
Expected_Result:
3: FAULT 0x10 (SENSOR) only - no UV fault; VMIN still 3700
4: OK,CELL1=0

Title: Fault latching after condition disappears
Expected_Result: 3: still FAULT 0x04, FETs OFF (fault latched until CLEAR_FAULTS)

Title: Multiple simultaneous faults
Expected_Result: FAULT with Faults 0x05 (OV + OT) - both reported

Title: Operating state transitions by current
Expected_Result:
99: IDLE

Title: Basic commands
Steps:
1. PING
2. GET_VERSION
3. GET_CELL,0  and  GET_CELL,3
4. GET_CELL,4  /  GET_CELL,A  /  GET_CELL
Expected_Result:
1: OK,PONG
2: OK,VERSION=1.0.0
3: OK,CELL0=3700 / OK,CELL3=3700
4: ERR,ARG for each

Title: Corrupted CRC is rejected and not executed
Preconditions: OT fault latched and released (temp back to 250 + @TICK 1)
Expected_Result:
1: ERR,CRC
2: still FAULT (command was not executed)
3: OK,CLEARED

Title: Malformed frames
Expected_Result:
1: ERR,FORMAT (missing $)
2: ERR,FORMAT (missing *)
3: ERR,FORMAT (non-hex CRC)
4: ERR,FORMAT (empty payload)
5: ERR,FORMAT (garbage); console keeps working

Title: Over-length frame and recovery
Steps:
1. Send a command of 60 X characters (64-char frame)
2. Send a command of 61 X characters (65-char frame)
3. PING
Expected_Result:
1: ERR,UNKNOWN_CMD (length accepted)
2: ERR,LENGTH
3: OK,PONG (link recovered)

Title: Unknown and case-sensitive commands
Expected_Result:
1: ERR,UNKNOWN_CMD
2: ERR,UNKNOWN_CMD (commands are case-sensitive)
3: ERR,UNKNOWN_CMD

Title: Power cycle clears RAM state
